top_signals.title: China LGFV Says It Can Repay Debt as Bond Sale Hits Snag
top_signals.summary: A Chinese municipal borrower said it has enough funds to repay 1.08 billion yuan ($160 million) in offshore notes due next week, after people familiar with the matter said a plan to refinance that debt with a new bond sale had been delayed.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
